chunk_findings.detail: The fix marks every preserved round as free, but never bounds how many times a preserved pass may be reused. Given `[review].max_rounds = 2`, one real full pass followed by repeated reviewer outages makes each subsequent delta attempt go through `_keep_reviewed_round` with `round_kept=True`; `_full_rounds`/`_delta_rounds` then ignore all of them. Since the kept record still carries the prior `"passed"` outcome, the gate continues to pass while `_rounds_used` stays at 1. That lets an arbitrary number of later diffs auto-pass with no new reviewer report, effectively bypassing the max-rounds limit outside the `ddflow review --force --reason` agent path. See [D-review-force-with-reason].

chunk_findings.detail: The fix only excludes review runs that carry the new `round_kept` key, but that key is written only when `_keep_reviewed_round` creates the copy after this change. Review items already recorded with the old buggy code have the preserved copy re-emitted with the prior `review_kind` and no `round_kept`, so `not r.evidence.get("round_kept")` is still true and the old copy is still counted. For example, an existing item that already had one full pass plus one reviewer outage before this upgrade still makes `_full_rounds`/`_rounds_used` return 2, so the next review stays blocked. The filter needs to recognize kept copies from already-persisted evidence (or add a migration), otherwise the bug remains for exactly the affected in-flight items.

chunk_findings.detail: In the bug’s 2-round budget configuration this test is already at the review limit after the first full pass plus the first successful `_fix`/`_review` delta. The third `_review` is therefore rejected by the budget check before `_keep_reviewed_round` is reached, so no kept copy is recorded. On the unfixed `_delta_rounds` (without `and not _kept_copy(r)`), the assertions still pass because `_delta_rounds` remains 1. Removing the `_kept_copy` clause from `_delta_rounds` would not make this test fail, so it does not actually guard the delta-copy case it claims to test.
